summary: American Tower Corporation filed an 8-K announcing the pricing of a registered public offering of €750 million senior unsecured notes due 2033, with a 4.000% interest rate and an issue price of 99.663% of face value. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a change-of-control or special situation. The filing contains no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. Accordingly, this filing does not meet the criteria for any special-situations category.
